column3: Hmm...
Hello world!
Demonstration!
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Shut up with these weird dialogue demonstrations.
Not sure what they meant by that.
Have you ever tried stand-up comedy, Navy?
I have no interest in such frivolous matters.
Oh well. Does the zooming work?
The camera has moved as well. Check the alignment, please.
It’s a bit off-center, don’t you think?
Let’s try to fix that.
Still a bit more...
More to the left, just a little...
Alright, fine, that works. We don’t really need to be incredibly precise.
Yeah, I just said that works. It’s way too close to my face already!
Cool. Please, don’t touch the camera anymore.
Just step from it away slowly... it’s already good as it is. Thanks!
Anyway... Sat is a huge Formula 1 fan, you know?
I know there’s an image of the Silverstone circuit in the game files.
...interesting.
I guess so! I’ll pull it up.
Alright, new rule: No more rummaging through the development files.
Aww...
Eh.
Oh well.
